prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; find src -name '*.py' | head -50; mypy 2>&1 | tail -50
cat src/trailhead/elevation.py; sed -n 1,60p src/trailhead/pace.py; sed -n 1,60p src/trailhead/report.py; cat src/trailhead/track.py
cat README.md; grep -rn "ele\b\|None" src tests | grep -v "^src/trailhead/track.py"; ls tests; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15
cat src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/cli.py tests/conftest.py; sed -n 1,30p tests/test_elevation.py

cat >> tests/test_track.py <<'EOF'


def test_missing_elevations_take_the_nearest_earlier_then_later_one():
    track = parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n0,0.02,120\n0,0.03,\n0,0.04,90\n")
    assert track.elevations() == [120, 120, 120, 120, 90]


def test_a_track_without_any_elevation_is_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(TrackError, match="no point has an elevation"):
        parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n")
EOF
grep -n "^from\|^import" tests/test_track.py; mypy && ruff check && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
